scientific_integrity: Exact generator proof and independently executed semigroup checker; finite tests do not replace proof. Self-review only, with no independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies to Brownian active segments, Poisson reflection-contraction resets, and exponential frozen refractory intervals, for D,r,b>0 and 0<u<1. Claims no result for nonexponential rests, general multipliers, or higher-order distributions; priority relative to unexamined general correlation theorems remains uncertain.
title: A golden-ratio boundary for reversal and oscillation of reflection-reset Brownian autocovariance
